themes.title: Nvidia backs OpenAI's ~$105bn Ohio data centre
themes.summary: OpenAI is leasing a giant new data-centre campus in Ohio and Nvidia is funding the first phase with up to ~$105bn (Bloomberg) or $100bn (FT), plus a $1.5bn energy investment. It is the latest escalation in frontier-lab capex and tightens the Nvidia-OpenAI interdependence.
themes.angle: Data-centre capex is moving from a software affair to a balance-sheet one — a signal for anyone pricing compute supply.

items.title: Nvidia Will Back First Phase of OpenAI Ohio Project With as Much as $105 Billion
items.note: Nvidia will spend up to $105bn on the data-centre campus OpenAI is set to lease in Ohio.

items.title: Nvidia pledges $100bn backing for OpenAI data centre in Ohio
items.note: FT separately reports ~$100bn backing plus a $1.5bn investment into a SoftBank-founded energy firm.

items.title: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project
items.note: OpenAI frames the Ohio campus as community investment supporting thousands of Southern Ohio jobs.

themes.title: Anthropic revenue run-rate tops $65bn pre-IPO
themes.summary: Bloomberg reports Anthropic's annualized revenue is now above $65bn, up more than sevenfold from the end of last year, ahead of an expected IPO. The run-rate signals enterprise demand for frontier models keeps compounding, though IPO timing is unconfirmed.
themes.angle: Scaling-lab revenue estimates are the cleanest demand proxy for enterprise AI spend.

items.title: Anthropic's Annualized Revenue Surpasses $65 Billion Before IPO
items.note: Run-rate above $65bn per Bloomberg sources, up more than 7x from end of last year.

items.title: Dario Amodei logs on to answer the critics
items.note: Rundown notes Amodei publicly addressing critics as the IPO narrative builds. (via GN)

themes.title: Saudi PIF records record 2025; deep-tech tilt grows
themes.summary: Saudi Arabia's PIF closed 2025 with revenue of $120bn and net profit more than doubling to $17bn, contributing 11% of non-oil GDP (AGBI, Economy Middle East). It separately disclosed a $26.38bn SpaceX stake, reinforcing a deep-tech-focused allocation strategy.
themes.angle: Sovereign-wealth AI allocation is no longer a side bet — it is core to non-oil GDP targets.

items.title: Saudi PIF revenue rises 9 percent to $120 billion as profit more than doubles to $17 billion
items.note: PIF 2025: revenue $120bn (+9%), net profit more than doubles to $17bn.

items.title: PIF contribution to Saudi non-oil economy rises nearly $100bn
items.note: PIF now accounts for 11% of Saudi non-oil GDP in 2025 (up from 10%), adding ~$100bn.

items.title: Saudi Arabia's PIF discloses $26.38bn stake in SpaceX
items.note: PIF disclosed a $26.38bn SpaceX stake, underscoring deep-tech allocation. (via GN)

themes.title: Gulf enterprises push agentic AI into core operations
themes.summary: UAE telecom e& says it is the first regional provider to embed agentic AI in core plans, FAB is driving enterprise AI adoption, and Dubai Customs credits AI with top-decile competitiveness. A WIRED ME report covers an AI-powered cyberattack on UAE critical sectors.
themes.angle: The region is moving from AI pilots to agentic AI embedded in core commercial products.

themes.title: UAE deepens AI deal flow and Arabic-language research
themes.summary: Abu Dhabi's MGX co-leads a $5bn Databricks round, while MBZUAI and Abu Dhabi researchers push Arabic-language capability — benchmarking 13 dialects and documenting how current models struggle with them. Regional capital meets a regional-language gap.
themes.angle: Arabic AI is a distinct, under-served market where Gulf capital has a first-mover opening.

themes.title: Inference economy: Stripe-OpenRouter, Higgsfield, GLM-5.3
themes.summary: The inference-economy layer is consolidating: Stripe's ~$7bn OpenRouter acquisition (via TLDR/tbreak), a $5.4bn valuation for AI-video startup Higgsfield (FT), and TLDR's round-up on GLM-5.3 and agent-consensus efforts. Model routing is becoming a payments-adjacent business.
themes.angle: Whoever owns model routing and payments may capture the toll on the inference economy.
